g.title: G
g.text: Figure J-13. Conceptual system architecture: trust boundaries B1-B7, sensitive data [brackets], attack surfaces and controls

g.title: cluster_b1
g.text: B1 Physical / RF / optical - attack surface: skimming, relay, fake credential

g.title: cluster_b2
g.text: B2 Gate LAN - attack surface: reader housing, debug ports, rogue server

g.title: cluster_b3
g.text: B3 Services - attack surface: APIs, injection, misconfiguration (OWASP ASVS L2)

g.title: Cred
g.text: Credential: AES smart card | phone NFC (Ed25519) | dynamic signed QR | visitor pass
[secret: per-card key / phone private key - never transmitted]

g.title: Reader
g.text: holds: own client cert, public keys, signed revocation list, encrypted event buffer
NO master keys | signed firmware | tamper switch | rate limit

g.title: Tablet
g.text: role-limited UI (photo + first name + role + decision)
no local personal data | auto-clear | privacy hood

g.title: HSM
g.text: master diversification key | token & list signing keys | decision signing key | checkpoint key

g.title: App
g.text: B6 Student app / portal - attack surface: malware, rooted device
hardware keystore | TLS pinning | enrol, dynamic QR, HCE, report lost, view own

g.title: Admin
g.text: B5 Admin console - attack surface: session hijack, insider
MFA | RBAC (Issuer / Approver / Auditor / Policy) | step-up confirm | session timeout

g.title: Host
g.text: B7 Host / Approver -> Visitor phone or printout - attack surface: forwarded pass
